title: Agent Invocation Progressed Event
description: A running agent invocation said what it is doing: one interim assistant message (the text a model writes alongside its tool calls, e.g. 'Checking the board first.'), published by the Hermes gateway while the turn is still running. 0..n per invocation, between agent.invocation.started and agent.invocation.completed|failed; never the final reply (that is read from the session). Same correlationid, causationid = the invocation.started event. Consumers throttle; the producer publishes every non-blank interim message. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

command_id.description: command_id of the bloodbank.agent.invocation.start or .invoke command this turn runs.

seq.description: 1..n per command, in the order the gateway saw the messages. A gap means a publish failed.

text.description: The interim message, trimmed and cut to 500 characters (text_truncated says whether it was cut).

elapsed_seconds.description: Seconds since the gateway dispatched the turn to Hermes.

context.description: Echo of the originating command's data.context, verbatim (a voice memo's carries memo_id). Omitted when the command carried no context.

lane.description: Delivery lane of the originating command: batch (bloodbank.agent.invocation.start) or interactive (bloodbank.agent.invocation.invoke).
